caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with an oval-shaped top, rendered in shades of brown. The table surface consists of three sections: a central rectangular piece and two semi-oval drop leaves on either side. The table is supported by eight legs, each turned and carved with rounded bulbous shapes and narrow sections, all in the same brown wood tone. The legs are connected by multiple horizontal stretchers that form a rectangular frame near the base, with an additional crossed stretcher in the middle for support. The background is plain and a light beige color, with no additional objects or decorations surrounding the table. There is a signature in the bottom left corner that reads "Frank Weiser."
title: Gate-legged Table
